title: Henrik Ibsen Easton Press Three Plays Collectors Edition Genuine Leather Binding
descriptionText: This is a rare and highly sought-after collectors edition of Henrik Ibsen's Three Plays. The book is bound in genuine leather and features special attributes that make it a must-have for any literature enthusiast. The plays are written in English and showcase Ibsen's masterful storytelling skills. The book is published by Easton Press and is categorized as antiquarian and collectible. It is a great addition to any book collection and a valuable find for any collector. Get your hands on this unique edition of Ibsen's Three Plays today!
